cards.title: Client & Factory Resiliency
items: Hardware USB/Bluetooth scanner emits rapid keystrokes intercepted in under 35ms
Terminal Outbox traps mutations in IndexedDB during network cuts with automatic flush
Bilingual English/Nepali zero-CLS layout switcher supports all factory shift workers

cards.title: Backend Integrity & Observability
items: Vercel Edge rewrites /api/backend/* directly into Render, enforcing 1st-party SameSite=Lax cookies
Correlation middleware tags every transaction with unique X-Request-ID (req_xxxxxxxxxxxx)
Pessimistic row locking (Product.with_for_update) eliminates negative stock overselling

cards.title: State Persistence & Statutory Tax

Serverless Neon PostgreSQL with PgBouncer connection pooling and 7-day PITR disaster recovery
